items.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows Friday, the first full trading session after the $6.4 billion Binance hack, ending October with roughly $516 million in net outflows.

items.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
items.summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

items.title: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says
items.summary: Michael Selig said the record $6.4 billion theft shows why offshore exchanges should register with the CFTC and adopt U.S.-grade cybersecurity standards.

items.title: Inside the largest crypto hack on record: How attackers breached Binance for $6.3 billion
items.summary: Investigators tie the $6B Binance hack to North Korea. Here's how hot-wallet signing infrastructure was compromised and where funds went.

items.title: Binance opens crypto withdrawals in phases starting with bitcoin following $6.3 billion hack
items.summary: Binance reopens customer withdrawals following a record $6.3 billion exploit. Bitcoin leads the first phase.
